groups.activity: research Detonite Injector, then Sydon, then Twin Krohkur
groups.meta: 72h each, sequential; skip if your clan already has it

rows.label: Detonite Injector research
rows.note: 5,000 cr, 5 Detonite Ampule, 200 Ferrite, 250 Polymer Bundle, 100 Plastids

rows.label: Sydon research
rows.note: 5,000 cr, 5 Nitain Extract, 16,500 Ferrite, 12,000 Alloy Plate, 4,650 Rubedo

rows.label: Twin Krohkur research
rows.note: 5,000 cr, 200 Detonite Ampule, 4 Gallium, 3,250 Ferrite, 300 Oxium

conditions: Costs shown are Ghost Clan (x1) tier; bigger clan tiers multiply them (x3/x10/x30/x100).
Each prerequisite must finish researching before the next starts; established clans have usually already cleared this chain.

groups.meta: 10 Tellurium and 16 Morphics needed for 2 Krohkurs
groups.mode: Steel Path with Nekros or Khora, resource and drop-chance boosters
conditions: Treat this as a volume farm, not a quick stop: normal-mode runs commonly return zero Tellurium in 20-30 minutes.
The Sentinel Spare Parts trick and the old Perita Rebellion (Recall: Hunhullus) Tellurium source are both patched out; ignore guides recommending them.
bonuses: Steel Path Ophelia with Khora reportedly returns 9 Tellurium in 20 minutes with a booster.
Railjack Veil Proxima (Lu-yan Survival) also drops Tellurium heavily and doesn't need your own good Railjack; join someone else's mission.
Daily login rewards hand out Tellurium on the side.

disclosures.title: stack boosters
disclosures.body: Resource booster (2x quantity), drop-chance booster (2x chance) and the relay Drop Chance Blessing (1.25x) all stack; commonly recommended for Ophelia runs. Go solo or with a pre-made squad if you want Nekros's Desecrate value — public players routinely ignore the Desecrate zone.

groups.activity: kill Grineer enemies for Detonite Ampule drops
groups.meta: 50 for 5 Injectors, plus up to 205 more if funding the dojo research solo

rows.label: Detonite Ampule
rows.alt: Invasions listing Detonite Injector as a reward give 3 per completion

conditions: Ampules drop singly and are common but spread out; expect a boring, low-intensity grind rather than a fast farm.

groups.activity: build 2 Krohkur and 5 Detonite Injector, then Twin Krohkur
groups.meta: 1 day each Krohkur, 12h each Injector, then 1 day

rows.label: Krohkur
rows.note: 25,000 cr blueprint from the Market (buy twice); each build 20,000 cr, 5 Tellurium, 8 Morphics, 125 Oxium, 4,375 Alloy Plate

rows.label: Detonite Injector
rows.note: 15,000 cr blueprint from the Chem Lab; each build 15,000 cr, 10 Detonite Ampule, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage, 250 Plastids

conditions: Rank the first Krohkur to 30 before crafting the second — both copies are consumed, but Mastery from a weapon sticks once earned.
Twin Krohkur is untradeable, so there is no shortcut via trading the finished weapon.
